title: Similar: Feedstock Loss Estimator
goal: Parse a noisy binary STL, isolate the largest connected component, extract its material ID from triangle attribute bytes, and compute the print feedstock mass required after applying a material-specific waste factor, writing the result to /root/feedstock_plan.json.
skillBenefitRationale: Preserves the source task's core mesh-analysis payoff almost directly: robust binary STL parsing, largest-component isolation, attribute-byte material extraction, and volume-driven engineering calculation, with only a modest downstream extension beyond raw mass.
